content.text: Hello English learners, welcome back to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.
content.trans: 您好，英语学习者，欢迎再次来到英语pod。我的名字是马科。

content.text: And my name is Erica.
content.trans: 我的名字是艾瑞克。

content.text: Today we're bringing you another one of our sports lessons and this time we're going to go to a boxing match.
content.trans: 今天，我们将为您带来我们的体育课程，并且这次我们将会去打一场拳击比赛。

content.text: That's right. So we're going to be learning language that you can use if you're talking about boxing, but not only boxing, right?
content.trans: 正确。我们将会学习你能够使用的语言，如果你谈论的是打拳，但不仅仅是打拳。

content.text: Right. We can also use this language for describing a fight or somebody that's fighting.
content.trans: 正确。我们也可以使用这种语言来描述一场战斗或正在战斗的人。

content.text: Okay, so not that we're asking our listeners to get into fights, but if ever you see a fight, at least now you'll have the language to talk about it.
content.trans: 好的，所以不是我们要求听众参与冲突的活动，但如果你看到一场冲突，至少现在你有了与之讨论的语言。

content.text: Exactly. So let's listen to a dialogue for the first time. It might sound familiar. We have the legendary Rocky Balboa at EnglishPod fighting for the Heavyweight Championship. So let's see what happens.
content.trans: 是的。那么让我们先听一次对话。听起来可能有点熟悉。我们有著名的罗比·巴里奥斯在英语pod上对抗重量级冠军。让我们看看会发生什么。

content.text: Welcome back boxing fans. My name is Rick Fields and here with me is the man with the Iron Jaw, Bob Copeland.
content.trans: 欢迎回到打拳爱好者。我的名字是Rick Fields，与我一起的还有身手矫健的Bob Copeland先生。

content.text: Thank you, Rick. We're coming to you live from Las Vegas. We're in the beautiful MGM Grand Hotel and Casino.
content.trans: 非常感谢Rick。我们正在实时与您见面，来自拉斯维加斯的美丽MGM Grand酒店和赌场。

content.text: Where the World Heavyweight Championship is about to get underway.
content.trans: 正在举行的世界 heavyweight 战士锦标赛即将开始。

content.text: That's right, Bob. We're about to witness the legendary Italian Stallion himself, Rocky Balboa, square off against his lifetime rival Apollo Creed. This will be a gruesome match for sure.
content.trans: 是的，鲍勃。我们即将见证意大利赛马之王罗伯特·巴尔达诺与他一生的对手阿波罗·克里斯丁之间的激烈对决。这将是一个非常血腥的比赛。

content.text: Both fighters are in the ring and we are about to begin.
content.trans: 两人都在场，我们即将开始。

content.text: In the blue corner, weighing in at 220 pounds, the former Heavyweight Champion of the world, the master of disaster, the one and only Apollo Creed.
content.trans: 在蓝角角落，重达220磅的前世界 heavyweight冠军、灾难之王、唯一阿波罗·克里斯汀。

content.text: In the red corner, weighing 218 pounds and with a record of 47 wins and 37 knockouts, the undefeated, undisputed Heavyweight Champion of the world, the Italian Stallion Rocky Balboa.
content.trans: 在红圈中，重达218磅，并且有47胜和37负的无冕之王、世界无冕重量级冠军意大利马特奥·巴尔达科。

content.text: There's the bell and this fight is underway. Apollo quickly attacks Rocky with quick strong jabs. Rocky dodges successfully and counterattacks with a strong right hook.
content.trans: 这里有一个铃铛，这场战斗正在进行。阿波罗迅速攻击雷克斯，用快速有力的戳击成功地反击了他。雷克斯顺利躲过了攻击，并以强有力的右勾拳回应。

content.text: Apollo is cut. Rocky landed a strong blow to his right eyebrow and cut him. This is his chance.
content.trans: 阿波罗被切。罗比用力拍了拍他的右眉毛，将他切伤。这是他的机会。

content.text: Rocky quickly throws a left. Right. Another left. Apollo is getting pounded. Apollo recovers with a powerful haymaker and catches Rocky off guard.
content.trans: 李奥尼迅速左转。右转。再左转。阿波罗被打得头破血流。阿波罗用一个强大的犁铧抓住了罗比，让他措手不及。

content.text: He's down. The ref starts the count.
content.trans: 他下来了。计时员开始计数。

content.text: One, two, three, one.
content.trans: 好的，以下是“一、二、三、一”这句话的翻译成中文：

content.text: Wow, sounds like a great fight.
content.trans: 哇，听起来像是一个很好的战斗。

content.text: Amazing fight and I don't know who's going to win. Rocky apparently got knocked down. What do you think will happen?
content.trans: 惊人的战斗，我不知道谁会赢。罗比似乎被打倒了。你怎么看？

content.text: Well, if I know anything about Rocky Balboa, he will not stay knocked down for long.
content.trans: 嗯，如果我了解罗比·巴乔，他不会长时间被压住。

content.text: Alright, so let's take a look at some of the language we saw in this dialogue in language takeaway.
content.trans: 好的，让我们看看我们在对话中看到的一些语言。

content.text: Well, Rickfield said that we have a very gruesome match tonight.
content.trans: 很好，里奇菲尔德说今晚的比赛非常惨烈。

content.text: A gruesome match.
content.trans: 一个血腥的比赛。

content.text: A gruesome. Alright, so if something is gruesome.
content.trans: 一个血腥的。好了，如果某个东西是血腥的。

content.text: It's really, it's bad, it's terrible, it's bloody.
content.trans: 是的，是真的。太糟糕了。太可怕了。太惨烈了。

content.text: Okay, bloody, terrible, very hard or like gruesome fight would be a very bloody fight.
content.trans: 好的，血淋漓、惨烈、非常艰难或像悲惨战斗会是一场非常血腥的战斗。

content.text: Yeah, or a gruesome film.
content.trans: 是的，或者一部血腥电影。

content.text: Okay, very good. So gruesome.
content.trans: 好的，很好。那么恐怖。

content.text: Now they all, they mentioned that both fighters are in the ring.
content.trans: 现在他们都提到，两人都在场。

content.text: Both fighters are in the ring.
content.trans: 两人都在场。

content.text: The ring.
content.trans: 在中文中，"the ring"可以翻译为：

content.text: Okay, so the ring is the physical space where they fight.
content.trans: 好的，所以这个环就是他们对抗的地方。

content.text: But isn't it square?
content.trans: 但这不是正方形吗？

content.text: Yeah, it is square, it does not really circular, but it's called a boxing ring. I'm not really sure why.
content.trans: 是的，它是一个正方形，实际上并不像圆形，但它被称为拳场。我不太明白为什么。

content.text: Well, maybe one of our listeners knows and can tell us about that because I am not an expert on boxing.
content.trans: 嗯，也许我们的听众知道，因为我是不太了解摔跤。

content.text: But what I do know is our next word.
content.trans: 但是，我知道我们的下一个词。

content.text: They were describing Rocky Balboa's career and they said he had 37 knockouts.
content.trans: 他们正在描述罗比·巴里奥斯的职业生涯，他们说他有37次KO。

content.text: Okay, a knockout.
content.trans: 好的，一个终结。

content.text: A knockout.
content.trans: 一个击倒。

content.text: In this sense, knockout is a noun.
content.trans: 在这个意义上，KO 是一个名词。

content.text: A knockout is when the fighter hits the other fighter and he falls to the ground and he can't get up in 10 seconds because he's tired, he's dizzy, he's hurt.
content.trans: 一个决斗者是指当对手击倒自己并摔倒在地，他可以在10秒内站立不起来。因为疲惫、眩晕和受伤。

content.text: Okay, so that's a knockout.
content.trans: 好的，那么这就是一胜。

content.text: Okay, so this is a technical boxing word.
content.trans: 好的，这是技术拳击术语。

content.text: It's the action of falling to the ground and not getting up.
content.trans: 是落下地面，没有站起来。

content.text: Right, but there's also a verb, two knockout.
content.trans: 是的，还有动词，两个击倒。

content.text: Or to knock someone out, so.
content.trans: 或者用暴力手段打人，这样。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: So when you say, I knocked this guy out.
content.trans: 所以当你说，我打死了这个家伙。

content.text: It means I hit him so hard that he fell to the floor and maybe he was unconscious for a while.
content.trans: 这句话意味着我打得很狠，以至于他摔倒在地上，可能他还处于昏迷状态。

content.text: So he fell asleep basically.
content.trans: 所以，他基本上睡着了。

content.text: Almost.
content.trans: 几乎。

content.text: Yeah, so it's very similar, the noun form to the verb form.
content.trans: 是的，所以它非常相似，动词形式到名词形式。

content.text: Like basically if you knock someone out, you get a knockout.
content.trans: 基本来说，如果你把某人打倒在地，你就输了。

content.text: Okay, so two knock someone out, a knockout.
content.trans: 好的，那么两个人打人，一个被打倒。

content.text: All right, now for our next word, we saw as Apollo quickly began to jab Rocky Balboa.
content.trans: 好的，接下来的词我们看到阿波罗迅速开始打雷·巴萨诺。

content.text: So the noun, a jab.
content.trans: 所以，名词，一个“啊”。

content.text: So a jab, quick jabs.
content.trans: 所以一针，快速的刺。

content.text: So a jab is a kind of punch, right?
content.trans: 所以，一个戳是打的一种吗？

content.text: It's a fast short but not very strong punch.
content.trans: 它是一次快速的短击，但并不很有力。

content.text: Okay, so a technical boxing word, a jab.
content.trans: 好的，所以一个技术拳击术语，是勾拳。

content.text: Hey, jab.
content.trans: 你好，嘿。

content.text: This can also be a verb, right?
content.trans: 这个也可以是动词，对吗？

content.text: Right, so two jab.
content.trans: 正确，所以两个巴掌。

content.text: Mm-hmm.
content.trans: 对不起，我无法直接翻译成中文。不过，根据您提供的英文，请告诉我需要翻译的内容是什么？这样我可以更好地帮助您。

content.text: Two jab.
content.trans: 两个巴。

content.text: Now Apollo was throwing jabs and Rocky began to dodge.
content.trans: 现在阿波罗在扔石块，雷克斯开始躲闪。

content.text: All right, and that's our next word, two dodge.
content.trans: 好的，这是我们的下一个词，两个绕。

content.text: Dodge.
content.trans: Dodge 是一个中文的缩写，通常用于表示“避障”或“防撞”。在中文中，“ dodge ” 的意思是“躲避”，“避开”，或者 “避免”。

content.text: D-O-D-G-E, two dodge.
content.trans: D-O-D-G-E, 二脱。

content.text: All right, so if you dodge, you're trying to avoid getting hit.
content.trans: 好的，如果你们绕开，你们就是在躲避被碰。

content.text: Right, so you move your body so that you're not hit.
content.trans: 是的，您移动身体，以避免被撞。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确答案是：Exactly.

content.text: But we can also use it in different ways.
content.trans: 但是，我们也可以用它在不同的方式上。

content.text: Not only do you dodge when somebody's trying to punch you, you can also, for example, dodge a bullet.
content.trans: 你不仅能够避开试图用拳头打你的人，还可以，例如，躲避子弹。

content.text: Right, so when you dodge a bullet, you avoid some bad situation or some bad event.
content.trans: 正确，所以当你躲避子弹时，你避免了一些不好的情况或事件。

content.text: Right, so we have many examples of dodge used in other contexts, so why don't we listen to some examples?
content.trans: 是的，所以我们有很多例子在其他地方使用了绕弯子，所以为什么不听听一些例子呢？

content.text: Example one.
content.trans: 这个例子。

content.text: See that guy dodging through the traffic?
content.trans: 看那个躲过交通的家伙？

content.text: He's going to get hit by a car if he's not careful.
content.trans: 他如果不小心撞到一辆车，他会受到伤害。

content.text: Example two.
content.trans: Example two. 例二。

content.text: Well, the storm turns south, so it looks like we managed to dodge a bullet.
content.trans: 嗯，风暴转向了南边，所以看来我们成功地避开了子弹。

content.text: Example three.
content.trans: 翻译成中文是：

content.text: Look, you're the one who is in charge of sales and the numbers are down.
content.trans: 请看，你就是负责销售的负责人，数字下降。

content.text: It's your problem, so stop trying to dodge your responsibilities.
content.trans: 你的问题，所以不要再逃避你应负的责任。

content.text: You know, that word reminds me of another sport dodge ball.
content.trans: 我知道，那个字让我想起了另一个运动飞镖。

content.text: Oh, dodge ball, exactly.
content.trans: 哈哈， dodge ball，正好。

content.text: Same principle.
content.trans: 同原则。

content.text: Yeah, but that's an entirely different lesson.
content.trans: 是的，但这就是一个完全不同的道理。

content.text: I think we need to focus here on the boxing vocabulary.
content.trans: 我认为在这里需要集中关注拳击词汇。

content.text: So the announcers said that Apollo is getting pounded to get pounded.
content.trans: 所以播音员说，阿波罗正在被压得喘不过气来。

content.text: To get pounded.
content.trans: 要剁碎。

content.text: Now, if someone is getting pounded, they're getting hit really hard and a lot.
content.trans: 现在，如果有人被打得很重，他们承受的打击非常大。

content.text: Mm-hmm.
content.trans: 对不起，我无法直接翻译成中文。不过，根据您提供的英文，请告诉我需要翻译的内容是什么？这样我可以更好地帮助您。

content.text: So to get pounded.
content.trans: 所以要剁碎。

content.text: Get pounded.
content.trans: 得到剁碎。

content.text: And now we have one more word, and it's also another boxing term called a haymaker.
content.trans: 现在我们有一个额外的词，它也是另一种称谓，称为“打手”。

content.text: A powerful haymaker.
content.trans: 一个强大的脱粒机。

content.text: Okay, so Apollo received a powerful haymaker.
content.trans: 好的，所以阿波罗收到了一个强大的犁。

content.text: Now, this word is actually new to me.
content.trans: 现在，这个词对我来说是全新的。

content.text: So, Mark, what does it mean?
content.trans: 所以，马克，这到底意味着什么？

content.text: Basically, it's a very strong, very wild punch.
content.trans: 基本来说，它是一个非常强壮、非常野蛮的打击。

content.text: Okay, so you don't have really good form.
content.trans: 好的，你并不具备很好的姿势。

content.text: Your body is kind of moving all over the place.
content.trans: 你的身体在四处移动。

content.text: Right, so you don't have much balance, so you just throw your entire body and your fist
content.trans: 是的，你没有太多平衡力，所以你只是把全身和拳头全部扔出去。

content.text: at someone to hit them as hard as you can.
content.trans: 在某人面前，尽可能地打他们。

content.text: That's a haymaker.
content.trans: 这句话的中文翻译是：“那是一个麦秆。”

content.text: All right, a technical boxing word here for you guys.
content.trans: 好的，这里有一个技术拳击术语给你。

content.text: But now we've got some interesting phrases for you on Fluency Builder.
content.trans: 但是现在我们给你一些有趣的短语在 FluentU 中。

content.text: Fluency Builder.
content.trans: 流畅 builder.

content.text: All right, so on Fluency Builder today, we're going to take a look at some of these phrases,
content.trans: 好的，今天在 Fluent Builder 上，我们将对这些短语进行一些观察。

content.text: and we have four of them for you today, so let's get started with the first one.
content.trans: 和今天给你们四个人，让我们开始吧。

content.text: Well, the announcer has said that the boxing match was about to get underway.
content.trans: 嗯，解说员已经说比赛即将开始。

content.text: Okay, to get underway.
content.trans: 好的，出发。

content.text: To get underway.
content.trans: 开始行动。

content.text: So, again, this is another way of saying about to begin.
content.trans: 所以，再次，这就是开始的另一种方式。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 正确。以下是“right”的翻译：

content.text: All right, so we're about to get underway with this new project.
content.trans: 好的，我们现在将开始这个新的项目。

content.text: Or the meetings just about to get underway, so make sure everyone's here.
content.trans: 或者刚刚开始的会议，所以请确保每个人都到场。

content.text: Very good.
content.trans: 很好。

content.text: So, the match was about to get underway, and the sports announcer said that Rocky Balboa
content.trans: 所以，比赛即将开始，体育解说员说：“罗比·巴雷特。”

content.text: is going to square off against his lifetime rival.
content.trans: 他将与他的终身对手进行对决。

content.text: So, we're going to look at this phrase to square off against someone.
content.trans: 所以，我们将对这个短语进行一番较量。

content.text: All right, I'm going to square off against Jim.
content.trans: 好的，我准备和吉姆打一场对决。

content.text: All right, when you square off against Jim, you get ready to fight with him or to compete with him, right?
content.trans: 好的，当你对阵吉姆时，你准备好与他或竞争他吗？

content.text: Right, so we're about to have a one-to-one competition.
content.trans: 是的，我们现在将进行一对一的竞争。

content.text: So, this is like a sports word, but it's also really commonly used in a lot of different contexts.
content.trans: 所以，这就像一个体育词汇，但同时也非常广泛地在许多不同的领域中使用。

content.text: So, why don't we hear a few more examples of how we can use this phrase to square off?
content.trans: 所以，为什么我们不听听一些如何用这个短语来对峙的例子呢？

content.text: Example one.
content.trans: 例子一。

content.text: The two countries are moving their armies close to the borders as they prepare to square off in a border dispute.
content.trans: 这两国正在将他们的军队靠近边境，准备在边境争端中对峙。

content.text: Example two.
content.trans: 例二。

content.text: Italy and Brazil are squaring off in the final game this afternoon.
content.trans: 意大利和巴西将在今天下午进行最后的比赛。

content.text: Example three.
content.trans: 翻译结果如下：

content.text: Lees and Daniel squared off against each other in the marketing meeting today.
content.trans: 今天，莱斯和丹尼尔在今天的营销会议上进行了对决。

content.text: They were both pretty angry.
content.trans: 他们都是很生气的。

content.text: All right, so great examples, and I think we can use it now not only in boxing, but in other situations.
content.trans: 好的，所以好例子，我认为我们可以现在用它不仅在拳击，而且在其他场合。

content.text: Now, Bob said that Rocky landed a strong blow.
content.trans: 现在，鲍勃说罗比打了一个强有力的拳头。

content.text: To land a strong blow.
content.trans: 要打一场强手。

content.text: All right, so land a strong blow.
content.trans: 好的，那么强手来吧。

content.text: Now, let's break this down. So, a blow.
content.trans: 现在，让我们分解一下。所以，一个击。

content.text: A blow is a punch or a hit.
content.trans: 一个击是拳或打。

content.text: Okay, and when you land a strong blow, what happens?
content.trans: 好的，当你对一个强大的对手发起猛烈攻击时会发生什么？

content.text: You basically successfully hit your opponent with a punch or hit.
content.trans: 你基本上成功地击中了你的对手。

content.text: So, you hit them... so your fist meets their body.
content.trans: 所以，你打他们... 所以你的拳头撞击到了他们的身体。

content.text: Yes, so your fist landed on their body.
content.trans: 是的，所以你的拳头击中了他们的身体。

content.text: Mm-hmm, so I could also change this a little bit.
content.trans: 这句话可以翻译成中文为：

content.text: I could say I landed a punch.
content.trans: 我可以说我已经落下了。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 正确。以下是该短语的翻译：

content.text: In boxing terms, he landed a strong left jab.
content.trans: 在拳击术语中，他以强有力的左勾拳落到了地上。

content.text: Okay, so to land a blow.
content.trans: 好的，那么要降落一个炸弹。

content.text: The announcer described it as rock through a left.
content.trans: 解说者把它描述为石头。

content.text: To throw a left.
content.trans: 要扔左。

content.text: So, he said he threw a left and right.
content.trans: 所以，他说道他抛了一个左和一个右。

content.text: Now, again, we'll take this one apart.
content.trans: 现在，我们再把这个分开。

content.text: So, a left. What are we talking about?
content.trans: 所以，左。我们正在谈论什么？

content.text: Basically, a left punch, but we can omit punch.
content.trans: 基本来说，左拳，但我们可以省略拳。

content.text: Okay, so it's a punch with your left hand.
content.trans: 好的，所以是用左手打的这个拳。

content.text: Mm-hmm.
